name: Priestess
source:
A priestess with golden eyes. 

[Spoiler]She is the older twin, her younger sister being the blindfold girl. 

She is the "string cutter" who snips away the threads that bind people with emotions good and bad.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the in-game description]
